_meta.source: gsc-research.json "towns" (CGNDB names, LIO / BC municipal boundaries, Ontario MOH health unit boundaries), compiled 2026-10-08
method: Place names: 209 distinct place names in "<service> <place>, on" queries (20 of them are covered cities and were dropped), plus place names in other queries (Oro-Medonte, King City, Collingwood, Muskoka, Simcoe County, York Region, Niagara Falls, BC and Québec towns, London neighbourhoods).

Official names and coordinates: Canadian Geographical Names Database (NRCan) API https://geogratis.gc.ca/services/geoname/en/geonames ; cross-checked against GeoNames CA.zip (https://download.geonames.org/export/dump/CA.zip, admin2 = census division).
Municipality and upper tier (Ontario): point-in-polygon query on Ontario's "Municipal Bnd Lower And Single" layer (Land Information Ontario, LIO_Open03/MapServer/14).

Current Ontario public health unit: point query on the Ministry of Health "MOH Public Health Unit Boundary" layer (LIO_Open09/MapServer/44); unit names match https://www.ontario.ca/page/public-health-unit-locations (updated August 28, 2026).
BC municipality, regional district, health authority and HSDA: BC open data WFS (openmaps.gov.bc.ca).
2007 health region (for the 2012 radon survey): Statistics Canada 2007 health-region correspondence files (82-402-X), by census division.
Nearest covered city and km: great-circle distance from the place's CGNDB point to each city's point in cities70.json.
Population for the type label: Statistics Canada table 98-10-0011-01 (2021 population centres); otherwise Wikipedia (fetched) or GeoNames population.

Ambiguous names: when two or more official places share a name, the one in the same area as the other queried communities was chosen, and the others are listed under "alternatives"; Wikipedia was fetched to see which place each name usually means.
